properties.title: Serbia: crowds celebrate in Belgrade after Vučić admits defeat
properties.summary: Crowds celebrated in Belgrade after President Aleksandar Vučić conceded defeat for his ruling party in Serbia's snap parliamentary election, following nearly two years of student-led demonstrations.

properties.summary: Seventy years after Hungary's 1956 uprising against Soviet rule, Prime Minister Péter Magyar paid tribute to its victims as Ursula von der Leyen highlighted the importance of freedom and democracy.

properties.title: Trapped miner in coal mine in Turkey confirmed dead, bringing death toll to three
properties.summary: Three miners were killed and five injured, two of them seriously, in an explosion at a privately owned mine in northern Turkey.
